file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ToastProvider currently uses role="status" and aria-live="polite", and every Toast automatically dismisses after 5,000ms regardless of its kind. We should update ToastProvider so that error toasts use an assertive live region and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds.
